method: Manually traced 85 visible spine centerlines, with nearby long plastic edges used to refine slopes. Spacing is perpendicular center-to-center spacing, not empty edge-to-edge clearance.
uncertainty: Approximate image-plane measurements: centers about +/-3 px; angles about +/-0.4 to 0.7 degrees. Hidden discs are not counted. Three out-of-plane lean values are estimates.
